title: API Delta Catalog for Competitive Model Substitution — field-call anchored
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Objective: build a searchable, prioritized catalog of API/behavior deltas between target open models and Redwood-verified model variants that matter for enterprise customers when switching providers. The catalog will capture functional differences (streaming semantics, function/tool calling, structured output/JSON stability), performance deltas (latency p50/p95 for short/long context, tokenization differences), failure modes (rate-limit behaviors, truncated outputs, inconsistent stop sequences), and contractual/operational costs (token counting mismatch, billing unit differences, required prompt wrappers).

Why this ticket: Sales and SRE teams increasingly field high-friction model-substitution conversations with customers. To reduce churn risk and speed feasible fallback plans we need an evidence-backed catalog tied to buyer-journey signals and a small set of instrumentation hooks so substitutes can be evaluated automatically. Deliverables to ship: a doc-backed catalog in Confluence, a lightweight telemetry schema and DataDog dashboard prototype that flags high substitution-risk routes, and a field-note template for Solutions to capture customer-specific incompatibilities during calls.
acceptance_criteria: A Confluence catalog with at least 12 distinct delta categories (functional, performance, billing, failure-mode, tokenizer, streaming semantics, function-calling, structured output, rate-limits, auth/headers, content-filtering differences, upgrade paths) documented with 1–2 reproducible examples each
A prioritized substitution risk rubric (impact x probability) that maps deltas to customer persona outcomes (e.g., chat agent, document-RAG ingestion, embeddings-based search)

A telemetry schema (JSON) and a minimal DataDog dashboard that surfaces top-10 customer routes with substitution risk signals using existing request-level fields (model_id, route, avg_token_length, streaming_used, function_calls_count)
A field-note template for Solutions with 5 capture fields (customer_scenario, observed_delta, workaround, business_impact_estimate, linked_PR_or_case) and three example-filled notes from pilot calls
Sign-off from Sales lead (Monique Ruiz) and SRE lead (Kunal Patel) on catalog usefulness and dashboard signals
tasks: Interview 6 customer-facing reps to collect 10 real substitution pain points — owner: Diego Morales
Run 24 synthetic probes across 6 open models for short/long context generation and streaming semantics; produce reproducible examples — owner: ML Bench Team
Draft Confluence catalog and delta taxonomy; link reproducible examples and test code — owner: Ava Chen
Define telemetry schema and implementation notes for Redwood request logs (fields + sampling guidance) — owner: Observability Team
Create DataDog dashboard prototype and wire up synthetic probe metrics — owner: Reliability Engineering
Pilot field-note capture with Solutions on 3 enterprise calls and collect sign-off examples — owner: Solutions Engineering
